author: Unity
description:
The 2D Animation Sample package provides 2D characters in many different game styles that were used by internal Unity teams over the years, and are now available to users. Try it to learn about 2D skeletal animation and pixel art.

The name of this package refers specifically to the 2D Animation package available via the Unity Package Manager. 2D skeletal animation in Unity provides great benefits for those needing smooth, lightweight, and reusable animations. 

The samples use the 2D Animation package in combination with other 2D features like the 2D PSD Importer, sprite libraries, 2D Inverse Kinematics, and URP 2D lighting.

It also includes a set of samples of the Unity-Chan character made into pixel art in Aseprite. The samples were brought to Unity with the Aseprite Importer and their visual quality improved with the Pixel Perfect Camera component.

Get it for free on the Unity Asset Store: https://on.unity.com/2DAnimationSamples
title: 2D Animation Sample package on Unity Asset Store
